global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with chashu pork, menma, and a pink-naruto fish cake, alongside a dark nori sheet. Served in a white bowl, it rests on a dark wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and slight sheen from ambient light reflection.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly raised rim, and faint red pattern near top edge.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, golden-brown, glossy, swirling, speckled with green onions and floating ingredients.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, with visible surface ridges and slight curling edges.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a thick, browned slice with visible fat marbling and a slightly textured, seared surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, slightly glossy, with segmented, fibrous texture and visible seasoning specks on their surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: round, pale white, with pink swirl, slightly textured surface, and soft edges.
